_why: Easy chat words (src/easy_chat.c): each word is drawn in FONT_NORMAL in (a) the word-select list, WIN_INPUT_SELECT sEasyChatWindowTemplates (28 tiles = 224px), columns at x=(j*13+3)*8 = 24 and 128 (PrintWordSelectText) -> 104/96px per column; (b) the phrase frame window sPhraseFrameDimensions (24 tiles = 192px), words joined with sText_Clear17 '{CLEAR 17}' (PrintCurrentPhrase); an empty slot is 12 hyphens = 72px and the cursor code (UpdateMainCursor) uses 72px for an empty word. 72px is therefore the designed word width (also the widest original English word: DISAPPOINTED, ENCYCLOPEDIA, ...). Group names: PrintKeyboardGroupNames, x = col*84+10 -> widest original TRENDY SAYING = 75px fits either column.
